description.zh:
保证请求幂等性。

从客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求之间，该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25965~~)。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25965~~).

description.zh:
是否将当前伸缩组内的ECS实例或ECI实例添加到新增的服务器组。取值范围：

- true：添加。

- false：不添加。

默认值：false。
description.en:
Specifies whether to add the existing ECS instances or Elastic Container Instance (ECI) instances in the scaling group to the new server group. Valid values:

- true: Adds the instances.

- false: Does not add the instances.

Default value: false.
The region ID of the scaling group.
The ID of the scaling group.

description.zh: 负载均衡服务器组的相关信息集合。
description.en: The information about the load balancing server groups.

description.zh:
弹性伸缩将ECS实例或ECI实例添加到服务器组后，ECS实例或ECI实例使用的端口号。

取值范围：1~65535。

> ALB和NLB类型负载均衡该参数为必填参数，GWLB类型负载均衡不能设置该参数且默认值为6081。
description.en:
The port number used by an ECS instance or ECI instance after Auto Scaling adds the instance to the server group.

Valid values: 1 to 65535.

> This parameter is required for ALB and NLB load balancing server groups. You cannot configure this parameter in Settings for GWLB load balancing server groups, and the default value is 6081.
The ID of the load balancing server group.

description.zh:
负载均衡服务器组类型。取值范围：

- ALB：应用型负载均衡ALB（Application Load Balancer）。
- NLB：网络型负载均衡NLB（Network Load Balancer）。
- GWLB: 网关型负载均衡 GWLB（Gateway Load Balancer）。
description.en:
The type of the load balancing server group. Valid values:

- ALB: Application Load Balancer (ALB).
- NLB: Network Load Balancer (NLB).
- GWLB: Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB).

description.zh:
弹性伸缩将ECS实例或ECI实例添加到服务器组后，ECS实例或ECI实例作为后端服务器的权重。取值范围：0~100。

权重越高，ECS实例或ECI实例将被分配到越多的访问请求。如果权重为0，则ECS实例或ECI实例不会收到访问请求。

> ALB和NLB类型负载均衡该参数为必填参数，GWLB类型负载均衡不能设置该参数。
description.en:
The weight of an ECS instance or ECI instance as a backend server after Auto Scaling adds the instance to the server group. Valid values: 0 to 100.

A higher weight indicates that the instance is allocated more access requests. If the weight is 0, the instance does not receive any access requests.

> This parameter is required for ALB and NLB load balancing server groups. You cannot configure this parameter in Settings for GWLB load balancing server groups.

title.zh: 添加一个或多个负载均衡服务器组
title.en: Add one or more load balancing server groups

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ess attach-server-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --scaling-group-id asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq0000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --force-attach false --server-group Type=ALB Port=22 ServerGroupId=sgp-60ofsqhwer0b000 Weight=100 --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ess AttachServerGroups --region cn-hangzhou --ServerGroup.1.ServerGroupId 'sgp-60ofsqhwer0b000' --ServerGroup.1.Type ALB --ScalingGroupId 'asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq0000' --ForceAttach false --ServerGroup.1.Port 22 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --ServerGroup.1.Weight 100
